summary: Backend: 31/31 pytest tests passed (health, Commands CRUD, Bindings incl. cascade-delete, Profiles incl. seed + default-protection + single-active, Devices upsert, Logs, Macros, no _id leakage anywhere). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): all 4 tabs render. Remote: demo-banner shown, volume increments 30->36, mute toggles, mode/source cards highlight, unbound press shows 'non liée' toast via app-toast. EQ: 5 seeded preset chips (Plat/Cinéma/Musique/Voix/Boost Basses) render, activate emits success toast, save-preset opens name-prompt-modal, submit creates+activates+toasts, reset works. Bibliothèque: stats counters update, empty-state discover-cta appears, seeded command appears as cmd-card-{id}, bind-power opens command-picker-modal, picker-cmd selects and binds (turns green, 'Boutons liés' counter increments, GET /api/bindings reflects), delete-cmd removes the card AND cascades to remove the binding (verified via API). No critical or minor functional issues found.

issues: RN-Web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow' (cosmetic, web-only warning)
RN-Web console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents (cosmetic, web-only warning)

action_items: (Optional polish) Address RN-Web deprecation warnings about shadow*/pointerEvents in custom components for cleaner web preview console. Not blocking; warnings only appear on web.
No functional fixes required — backend + frontend (non-BLE) flows fully verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean separation, all endpoints use {'_id': 0} projection so no ObjectId leakage — verified by recursive assertion in tests.
server.py: delete_command correctly cascades to remove related bindings (line 223).
server.py: activate_profile atomically deactivates all then activates target (lines 280-281) — single-active invariant verified in tests.
useController.ts correctly handles unbound/disconnected/demo states with distinct toasts; isBound() drives the green link icon on remote.
api/client.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exclusively — no hardcoded URLs.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed commands/profiles/devices/macros/logs and clean them up (cleanup fixture + zz_cleanup test). Frontend playwright test seeded one TEST_FE command via POST /api/commands then deleted it via UI; TEST_FE_Preset profile was created via UI then cleaned via API. Plat preset re-activated after each run to restore default state.
